## Appendix: ID Reference

`{hierarchy-prefix}` is the dot-free hierarchy path of this MiniApp as registered in `artifacts.toml` — for the student MiniApp under the superapp platform it is `superapp-student`.

| ID Pattern | Example | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-prd` | `cpt-superapp-student-prd` | MiniApp PRD anchor |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-fr-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-fr-course-list` | Functional requirement |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-nfr-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-nfr-offline` | Non-functional requirement |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-interface-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-interface-deep-link` | Public interface |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-contract-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-contract-enrollments` | Integration contract |
| `cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-usecase-{slug}` | `cpt-superapp-student-usecase-browse` | Use case |
